note: Flat wings (04 §3.7 'плоские кулисы') cut from the front views of the concept collages; no Tripo. All sizes are PROPOSED (04:241, 17:398/719), not budgets. Pixel coordinates are in the source PNG (x right, y down); base_y is the exclusive bottom row of the object (ground contact). Segments are concatenated left to right and aligned at base_y; mirror=true flips the segment horizontally.

facades.composition_note: Gothic arcade. Source front view has 2 bays; 5 bays are built by chaining P=[40,212) (left pillar + left half of door 1), S=[212,500) (right half of door 1 + middle pillar + left half of door 2) and mirrored copies. Every seam is at a door centre and is either the original continuity or a mirror seam, so no texture discontinuity is introduced; doors 2..5 are symmetric by construction.

glow.why: door 2 (symmetric double door at a mirror seam): leaves ajar, warm slit from threshold to the cross bar

facades.composition_note: Half-timbered gable with a ruined stepped stone end. Two houses: B + mirror(B) joined at the ruined end (mirror seam at x=530), giving a row of two gables with a collapsed party wall between them; the eaves overhang at both outer ends.

glow.why: gap between the two shutter leaves (shutters ajar), warm light from inside
same window in the mirrored house

facades.composition_note: Stone ruin with a blind (stone-filled) arch and a pillar. Front view + mirrored back view of the same wall (top-right view of the collage: big blocks, pillar on its left) -> arch wall, pillar, high block wall stepping down, pillar. No opening in the concept, so no glow.
